### Reconnecting with God When You Feel Disconnected
Author: Jess Ward
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/reconnecting-with-god-when-you-feel-disconnected.html
Passage: James 4:8
Points:
- Spiritual distance rarely happens overnight; it usually develops through busyness, worry, and competing distractions.
- Feeling disconnected from God does not mean He has abandoned us, but that our divided desires have shifted our attention away from Him.
- God does not demand perfection, pristine spiritual routines, or eloquent words before we come to Him.
- Drawing near can begin with small, honest choices such as setting aside phones, praying honestly, or opening Scripture.
- When we take a single step back toward God, we find He has been waiting to welcome us near all along.

### Draw Near to God
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/draw-near-to-god
Passage: James 4:8
Points:
- God promises to meet us with forgiveness, love, and grace whenever we approach Him in sincere brokenness.
- Truly experiencing God's presence requires letting go of self-sufficiency and embracing humble helplessness.
- Drawing near to God is ultimately a response to His divine initiative, which often reaches us through painful circumstances.
- Satan seeks to turn trials and failures into barriers between us and Christ, but resisting the enemy allows us to draw closer to the Lord.
